sections.bio:
10+ years in business ops, 8 years in remote work: supporting teams as they scaled from 2 → 100+ across 3 continents and through acquisitions.

Now I write All Things Remote: a weekly newsletter for founders scaling remote teams.

My career spans workflows + processes, legal, culture, recruitment, finance, and project ops - always with a focus on building systems that let teams move faster and founders focus on growth

Over the past 8 years in remote work:

→ 7 years leading operations inside fully remote companies, scaling global teams (with several later acquired by Meta and global agencies).

→ The last year building my own business and writing All Things Remote, now read by 1,000+ remote leaders.

Since 2018, I’ve also lived and worked nomadically, proof that you can grow a business and a balanced life at the same time.

My strengths:
→ Remote team operations & workflow design
→ Async communication & leadership
→ Finance & ops strategy for scaling startups
→ Building strong team culture

How I can help you:
→ All Things Remote: weekly newsletter with practical tips to run your remote team smarter
→ Fractional COO support: hands-on ops & finance so you can focus on growth
→ Brand partnerships: reach remote founders & leaders through the ATR newsletter

Running a remote team? Subscribe to the newsletter or drop me a DM.

I'll help you run your remote team better :)
